architecture.mechanism: Position-sensor-free stop-position control using speed extrema to estimate top dead center for precise engine restart positioning.
architecture.intervention: Modify the Hyundai ECM software to calculate initial crank angle from motor speed signal extrema during the compression stroke, replacing reliance on potentially unreliable low-speed crankshaft sensor data for stop-position determination.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of engine reversal and stalling during idle-stop restarts by ensuring accurate piston positioning without triggering check engine lights or diagnosable error codes associated with sensor faults.
architecture.falsification_test: Instrument a test vehicle with high-resolution optical encoders to measure actual stop position versus ECM-estimated position using only speed signals; induce 1000 idle-stop cycles and verify zero stalls and zero diagnostic trouble codes while confirming position error remains below 2 degrees.
